name: LaBeau's Utah-Style Pastrami Cheeseburger
brandOrRestaurant: LaBeau's Drive-In (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: A Utah drive-in staple pairing a charbroiled beef patty with thin-sliced warm pastrami on a soft white bun; low in fiber, though higher in sodium, cured beef fat, and peppercorn spice than a plain cheeseburger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order on a plain bun with cheese only—skip raw onions, shredded lettuce, pickles, and heavy fry sauce.
watchOuts: Cured pastrami is seasoned with black pepper/coriander and adds extra fat and sodium—stick to a plain cheeseburger or grilled turkey sandwich during flares
